opening.argument: The description invites viewers to join a Forsage BUSD plan, and the slides lay out a matrix in which participants may arrive through direct invitations or spillovers from uplines and downlines. They assign payments across those tiers, then claim a 580% yield from one cycle and list one-cycle income figures, including 65,932.8 BUSD at a price of 9,696 BUSD. These are recruitment-linked payment flows and tiered returns presented as the plan’s structure. But the slides do not establish that any payments occurred or that the stated returns were realized or guaranteed. The evidence supports a recruitment-commission matrix pitch, not proof of completed earnings.
